steps.summary: Every size now belongs to a job: one headline sized to fit its column, one heading size for every section, larger body copy, and three font weights instead of four.

changes.what: Hero headline sized to its column: two balanced lines instead of three cramped ones
changes.after: clamp(3.25rem, 2.39rem + 4.12cqi, 3.75rem): 60px, 2 lines, derived from Inter Tight's 0.459em advance

changes.what: Section headings smaller and lighter, so the hero headline stays the one loudest line
The closing headline uses the same heading size as every other section
Feature, step and FAQ text is larger and easier to read
Feature, step and plan titles share one size
Fewer font weights, each with one job
changes.after: 3 weights (400 text, 600 headings and buttons, 700 hero headline only)

changes.what: Prices use tabular figures and a lighter weight
Icons in buttons sized to the label beside them (settling pass)

steps.summary: Orange text, the focus ring and quiet grey text now pass contrast everywhere they appear, and colour is spent on fewer, named jobs.

changes.what: Orange section labels are readable
changes.before: #e2512a, 3.86:1 on white, 3.60:1 on the tinted sections
changes.after: #bf4318, 5.21:1 on white, 4.87:1 on the tinted sections

changes.what: Text on orange badges switched from white to ink
The keyboard focus ring can be seen on every surface
changes.after: #bf4318, 5.21:1 on white, 4.87:1 on tint; #ff6a3d inside the dark bands, 6.65:1

changes.what: The quietest grey text passes on tinted sections too
Customer logos are a readable grey
Pricing ticks are ink instead of green, so the featured plan stands out
changes.after: 14 ink ticks on a grey circle

changes.what: Off-hours in the product preview are readable
Colours typed inline replaced by named tokens
changes.after: 0 (two third-party calendar dots marked as exempt)

steps.summary: The page stops being a wall of boxes: features, steps, quotes and questions sit on the page, grouped by space, with headings closer to what they introduce.

changes.what: Feature cards removed; features sit on the page in two columns, icon beside the text
changes.before: 6 bordered cards in 3 columns, about 38 characters a line
changes.after: no boxes, 2 columns, about 51 characters a line

changes.what: The three steps become one sequence on a shared line
changes.after: 3 columns on a 1px rule, each number sitting on it

changes.what: Testimonials marked by a quote bar instead of a card
changes.after: 3 quotes, each with a 3px orange bar

changes.what: FAQ becomes one list parted by hairlines
Headings sit closer to their content than to the section before
Far fewer boxes on the page
changes.after: 7 (three plans, the final card, the product preview's two windows, the hero pill)

changes.what: Corner radii on one ladder
One reading width shared by every paragraph block

steps.summary: Shadows now mean something: one raised button, one floating product preview, and a frosted header that falls back cleanly.

changes.what: Only the hero's main button is raised; other buttons sit flat
The featured plan is marked by its edge, not a floating shadow
Product preview shadow rebuilt as one light in layers
changes.after: inset highlight + contact + 2 ambient layers, peak 16%

changes.what: Shadow definitions consolidated
changes.before: 3 shadow tokens + 2 inline shadows + a coloured glow

changes.what: Frosted header tuned and given fallbacks
changes.before: blur 14px, no @supports guard, no reduced-transparency branch
changes.after: blur 20px + saturate 1.8 inside @supports; opaque under reduced transparency; ink edge under more contrast

changes.what: Decorative shadow and glow removed from the hero pill and best-hour cell
changes.before: pill shadow; orange glow under the 15:00 cell

steps.summary: Motion only marks real changes: the floating card settles instead of bobbing forever, nothing non-clickable reacts to hover, and reduced motion keeps the useful changes.

changes.what: The suggestion card drifts twice and rests instead of bobbing forever
Feature cards no longer lift on hover (they aren't links)
Customer logos no longer change colour on hover (they aren't links)
Durations on a ladder by how much changes
changes.before: 150ms and 200ms, all `ease`, including transform and box-shadow
changes.after: 120ms links, 200ms buttons, 280ms FAQ icon; colour on `ease`, movement on one curve

changes.what: Reduced motion keeps the signals instead of switching everything off
changes.before: every animation and transition removed with !important
changes.after: drift off, smooth scroll off, FAQ icon turns instantly; colour changes kept

steps.summary: Every element now does what it looks like it does.

changes.what: "See how it works" shows a down arrow, not a play icon, because it scrolls to the steps and there is no video
The support email is a real email link
